offer.title: Our Offer
offer.text: We offer a wide range of windows, frames, exterior doors, and sliding doors in PVC, wood and aluminium. Through expert craftsmanship, the highest quality materials, and a level of service we ensure our company's status. Each window and door is made to order, providing each customer with individual service and attention. We will provide you with the highest level of expertise and assist you all the way with your renovation and construction plans.

productDetail.colorsDesc: Customize your {{name}} with over {{count}} premium finishes, ranging from modern architectural solids to hyper-realistic woodgrains.
productDetail.glassDesc: DRUTEX, with over 30 years of experience in the production of composite glass, offers a very wide range of glass with which you can fit your windows and doors. They meet strict requirements for energy efficiency and sound insulation. The offer also includes laminated glass (safe and burglar-proof), sun protected glass, glass with enhanced sound insulation, tempered, ornamental and sandblasted glass.
productDetail.handlesDesc: Our window handles are distinguished by their excellent workmanship, functionality and durability. Available in multiple color variants to perfectly match your windows.

igloEdge.description: Our new, most technologically advanced window is distinguished by an excellent thermal insulation parameter of Uw = 0.66 W/(m²K)* and a modern, angular profile shape. The extremely good thermal insulation parameters are due, among other things, to the 7-chamber profile design and 3 EPDM gaskets, including the central gasket.
igloEdge.basicDescription: The IGLO EDGE window system represents the pinnacle of energy efficiency. Designed for passive houses and energy-conscious renovations, it features a 7-chamber profile, the best-in-class Uw = 0.66 W/(m²K), and a minimalist design that maximises natural light entering the room.
equipment: 4 anti-theft strikers according to the size of the sash and the hardware system
Perimeter, glazing and central gaskets in black or grey
Filling of the lower hardware groove
Wide selection of PVC veneer colours
3 profile colours to choose from: white, brown or anthracite
